activity.role: Opera and sacred music composer of Messa da Requiem
activity.notes: Representative historical PERSON-SPECIFIC milestone point (not a claim of a single year of career). Verdi's Requiem was premiered in Milan in 1874 to commemorate Alessandro Manzoni, an Italy-located artistic event. This avoids wrongly treating the 1871 Cairo premiere of Aida as if the performance took place in Italian territorial jurisdiction; Aida remains important in biographical notes.
